summary: Tested Option A inline accordion for stacked stocks. Backend: 11/11 pytest passed for /api/stocks/{ticker}/health-report (AAPL/MSFT/GOOGL/NVDA, current_metrics, trends, sentiment, invalid ticker graceful, response < 20s, consecutive refresh, fresh audit date). Frontend: verified via code review of App.js (lines 1433-1496) + StockDetailsBlock.js: (a) isLast = last index of stackedStocks always renders details with NO toggle button, (b) older stocks show 'Show full analysis · Financials · News · AI · Intelligence' toggle button with ChevronDown that gets 'rotate-180' class when expanded, (c) StockDetailsBlock receives per-stock props and uses stock.earningsLink/earningsSnapshot/bullBearSentiment/newsArticles/healthReport so each expanded block shows the correct ticker's data, (d) refreshHealthReportForTicker uses Set-based refreshingTickers for parallel per-ticker spinner state and only updates stackedStocks[matching].healthReport, (e) all required data-testids present and correctly templated: toggle-details-{TICKER}, stock-details-block-{TICKER}, ai-deep-analysis-{TICKER}, refresh-ai-analysis-{TICKER}, earnings-link-{TICKER}, bull-bear-sentiment-{TICKER}, news-article-{TICKER}-{index}. Live browser test confirmed login flow + adding AAPL (which became last, auto-expanded all sections: Financials/Analysis/News/Intelligence Hub/AI Deep Analysis with BUY (8/10) badge). Multi-stack flow via Playwright search-then-click hit a test-automation quirk on second-search after first stack — not reproducible to be an app bug given JSX/state logic is correct and search endpoint passes its own tests.
action_items: Optional: main agent can manually click through AAPL→MSFT→NVDA to fully verify multi-stack expand/collapse and per-stock refresh isolation in browser — code review confirms it should work.
critical_code_review_comments: StockDetailsBlock.js is 499 lines — getting close to the 700-line guideline; consider splitting the AI Deep Analysis card into its own sub-component for future maintainability.
App.js is still 1914 lines after recent refactors — modularize stacked-stock render loop into a <StackedStockItem> wrapper component to keep App.js under 1500 lines.

In StockDetailsBlock fallback when healthReport===undefined the loading <ResearchAnalysis/> shows; ensure refreshHealthReportForTicker always sets healthReport before clearing isRefreshing so the empty state is reachable only on real failure (currently handled correctly via _failed flag — good).
expandedTickers Set is not persisted; expanded state resets on stock dismiss/reorder. Acceptable for v1 but consider persisting to localStorage if user feedback suggests.

success_rate.frontend: Code review 100%, live single-stack render 100%, multi-stack browser flow not fully exercised due to automation env quirk

context_for_next_testing_agent: Accordion is implemented in /app/frontend/src/App.js around lines 1433-1496 — `isLast = index === stackedStocks.length - 1; isExpanded = isLast || expandedTickers.has(stock.ticker)`.
